strengths.point: Promoters hold a controlling majority - skin in the game.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
Institutional money has been flowing out.
weaknesses.evidence: NEGATIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change -2.87 pp

weaknesses.point: Foreign institutions have been cutting their stake.
Domestic institutions have been cutting their stake.

opportunities.point: The company expects strong double-digit volume growth supported by screen additions and rising footfall trends for FY27 and beyond.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Looking ahead to FY27 and beyond, we expect strong double-digit volume growth, supported by screen additions and rising footfall trends, we foresee continued revenue growth momentum driven by both ticket and non-ticket streams." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management expects margin stability supported by operating leverage and cost optimization.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We expect margin stability, supported by operating leverage and cost optimization." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: FY26 saw the company expand its operational footprint to 41 cinemas with 113 screens across 9 states.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "FY26 saw a step-up in our operational footprint as we expanded to 41 cinemas with 113 screens across 9 states." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company added 30 screens in H2FY26 alone.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "We added 30 screens in H2FY26 itself, demonstrating accelerated execution." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The Indian box office witnessed a sharp revival with overall collections growing between 15% to 20% on a YoY basis.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The Indian box office witnessed a sharp revival, with overall collections growing between 15% to 20% on a YoY basis." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Hindi cinema witnessed a strong recovery growing over 50% YoY.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Hindi cinema, in particular, witnessed a strong recovery, growing over 50% YoY, while regional cinema — especially Telugu and Tamil — continued to deliver consistent performance." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Total footfalls increased to 27.63 lakh admits, up approximately 63% YoY.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "We delivered strong operating metrics during the year with total footfalls increased to 27.63 lakh admits, up ~63% YoY." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Average Ticket Price increased to INR 264, up approximately 6% YoY.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Average Ticket Price increased to ₹264, up ~6% YoY." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company has 230+ upcoming screens planned across the FY27 and FY28 pipeline.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Looking ahead we have 230+ upcoming screens planned across FY27 and FY28 pipeline." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: The company expects to add around 80–85 more screens in FY26–27.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Based on our current plans and assumptions, we expect to add around 80–85 more screens in FY26–27, and potentially even exceed 100." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [FY27]

opportunities.point: For FY27–28, the company is targeting a growth of approximately 25% in terms of screens.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Similarly, for FY27–28, we are targeting a growth of approximately 25% or there abouts." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: Total debt as on FY26 is almost nil.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "► The total debt as on FY26 is almost Nil providing adequate room to raise debt in future." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -1.75 pp, DII -1.12 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S2/W8/O27/T4), led by 'The company expects strong double-digit volume growth supported by screen additions and rising footfall trends for FY27 and beyond', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
